Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Custom Bid is floated as Open Tender Enquiry (OTE) through GeM Portal for “MACHINING OF BASE BLEED MOTOR IN SEMI FINISHED CONDITION TO DRG. NO.: OFDC/SK-3367 WITH OFDC MATERIAL AND RETURN OF SCRAP.” for qty. 39782 Nos. Reverse Auction: Applicable with H1 elimination. Bid Distribution Criteria: L1:L2:L3 :: 50%:30%:20% at L1 rate Option Clause: 25% Applicable EMD: Rs. 95482.00/- or bid security declaration PSD: 5% Applicable (Not applicable if S.O. value is below Rs. 10 Lakhs) Inspection Authority: ED/OFDC or his authorized representative Inspection Type: Inspection at Buyer’s premises Documents required from Firm: GST, MSME, Udyam Aadhaar etc. Delivery Period: 180 Days Delivery Schedule: Minimum 2000 Nos. per week. Additional Terms & Conditions during Pre-Contract: 1) Firm must have to submit 02 Nos. advance sample with OFDC material as per drawing no. SK-3367 within 10 days of opening of bid after intimation from OFDC. Only those firms whose advance sample passed by inspection authority (Quality Assurance as well as User Section) of OFDC will be considered for technical evaluation. Otherwise offer will be rejected for non submission of samples. 2) OFDC can only issue material in as and when required basis. 3) Firm shall collect the material against Rs. 5077.61/- per nos. against bank guarantee. 4) Firm should strictly comply to the drawing. OFDC reserves the right to reject the offer of firm in case of dimensional deviation in sample

submitted by firm. 5) OFDC representative may visit firm premises during technical evaluation to verify manufacturing facilities of the firm. Additional Terms & Conditions during Post-Contract: 1) Firm must carefully handle the material during transit from OFDC to Firm’s Premises at their own arrangement including expenditure if any. 2) Delivery Schedule :- Firm should be capable of supplying minimum 1000 Nos. per week. 3) In case firm does not uphold its supply commitments of Delivery Schedule:- 7 days from issuance of raw material for a lot of 1000 nos., OFDC reserves the right to reduce S.O. qty./cancel S.O. if the above is not complied. Firm has to comply this clause , otherwise bid will be rejected. 4) OFDC reserves the right to carry out surveillance and visit anytime during operational period of S.O. and full cooperation is expected from the firm. 5) In case of Rectifiable defects, observed during QC inspection of bulk supply as per schedule, the defective qty to be repaired within 04 working days. 6) In case of Irreparable/non-rectified defects, the amount of raw materials cost to be recovered/deducted from pending bills / Bank Guarantee and defective components will be at OFDC and shall not be returned to firm to avoid mixing in future consignments. 7) The components should be submitted in finished condition without surface treatment. 8) OFDC shall have right to carry out chenical / any other relevant test to ensure that materials issued by OFDc is being utilized for manufacture of critical component. The decision of OFDC shall be final in this regard. 9) Firm should liase with user section for drawal of raw material and maintaining the requisite quality. 10) in case of delay in staggered supply of the first and consecutive lots, OFDC may impose LD or cancel the S.O. as per decision of competent authority. 11) Firm should arrange all the necessary gauges of their own. OFDC will not be liable to provide any gauge to the firm. 12) Firm should also note that mere submission of sample does not guarantee S.O. to the firm. 13) Scrap to be returned mandatorily on a scale of 1.51 Kg. per no. by the firm. Firm to quote accordingly. 14) OFDC reserves the right to issue the material as per performance of the firm. 15) Firm should submit Bank Guarantee for minimum 500 Nos.

Other Terms & Conditions: (1) Bulk quantity to be supplied at OFDC premises and bulk to be inspected at OFDC. (2) As per YILSPM’2024. Bank Guarantee Format for PBG and EMD is uploaded herewith. For any inquiry please contact Sri Akash Verma, Deputy General Manager, for Executive Director, OFDC, Phn. No. 033-2569-4012. Bidder may email at email id no. mmofdc@ord.gov.in . 11.
